hook_line: SHOURYA AMBURE, 17, WINS BRONZE — INDIA'S FIRST TRACK MEDAL AT DAKAR

hook_stat.sub: Personal best in the women's 100m hurdles final at the Dakar Youth Olympics

stats.label: Seconds behind silver medallist Anna Peeters of France, who ran 13.57
Her semi-final time earlier on Sunday — the first of two personal bests in one day
India's medal tally at Dakar after her bronze — three silver and five bronze

diaspora_bullets: India's only track and field athlete at the Games
Coached by Ajit Kulkarni, she has raced hurdles since the Under-14 category
news_summary: Shourya Ambure, 17, from Maharashtra, won bronze in the women's 100m hurdles at the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games, clocking a personal best 13.59 seconds — India's first track and field medal of the Games.
payoff: In the space of 18 months she has now won medals at the Asian U18 Championships, the Asian Youth Games and the Youth Olympic Games.
